assets.bodyText: A granary porter moves and checks the sacks that fill the storehouse. Honest attention at the doorway gives distant accounts a solid foundation, making the harvest a quantity that officials can actually find.

assets.subtitle: Scribe of the Nile Treasury

assets.subtitle: Examiner of the Granaries
assets.bodyText: A grain auditor compares the ledger with the storehouse and questions what fails to agree. Independent scrutiny gives administration its necessary resistance, exposing the costly distance between a promising account and an empty bin.

assets.title: Nearchus
assets.subtitle: Admiral of Alexander's Fleet
assets.bodyText: Nearchus commanded Alexander's fleet from the Indus towards the Persian Gulf. His account of the difficult coastal voyage, preserved through later writers, joined practical seamanship to an enduring record of unfamiliar shores.
assets.rarityCharacteristics: amethyst and gold, interlaced corner knots, gem rails

assets.subtitle: Crew of Nearchus' Ships
assets.bodyText: A fleet deckhand tends lines, stows gear, and answers the work of another tide. Dependable hands keep the vessel ready for orders, giving the admiral's distant destination a practical beginning on deck.

parentVariants.title: Demetrius the Besieger
parentVariants.subtitle: King of Siegecraft
parentVariants.bodyText: Demetrius Poliorcetes pursued kingship through bold campaigns and spectacular siege machinery. His famous assault on Rhodes ended in negotiation, yet its scale fixed his enduring reputation as the Besieger of Cities.
parentVariants.rarityCharacteristics: full art, gilded perimeter, radiant nameplate and figure emblem

parentVariants.title: Zeno of Citium
parentVariants.subtitle: Founder of the Stoa
parentVariants.bodyText: Teaching at Athens' Painted Porch, Zeno founded the Stoic school around 300 BCE. His philosophy placed virtue and reason at the centre of a demanding vision of how a life should be lived.
parentVariants.rarityCharacteristics: full art, gilded perimeter, radiant nameplate and figure emblem

parentVariants.title: Ptolemy I Soter
parentVariants.subtitle: Founder of a Dynasty
parentVariants.bodyText: A general of Alexander, Ptolemy secured Egypt after the conqueror's death and later ruled as king. His dynasty made Alexandria a royal capital and endured until the age of Cleopatra.
parentVariants.rarityCharacteristics: full art, gilded perimeter, radiant nameplate and figure emblem

parentVariants.title: Cleomenes of Naucratis
parentVariants.subtitle: Financier of Alexander's Egypt
parentVariants.bodyText: Appointed by Alexander to administer Egyptian revenue, Cleomenes became a powerful financial official. His control of grain and taxation amassed wealth, while ancient accounts also preserve accusations of ruthless exploitation and profiteering.
parentVariants.rarityCharacteristics: plain iron, single rule, square corner joints
